_about: Sir Alfred Eckhard Zimmern (1879-1957), classicist and theorist of international relations. Not Helen Zimmern (shelf helen-zimmern). He died in 1957, but both books here were published before 1930. Raw IA OCR: The Greek Commonwealth, politics and economics in fifth-century Athens (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1911); Nationality and Government, with other war-time essays, new edition (London: Chatto and Windus, 1919). Project Gutenberg's The War and Democracy (PG 10668) is a multi-author volume and is not taken. US public domain. No uids minted.
